blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The PBA has fined Calvin Abueva a total of P24,000 for his actions during Converge’s 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series-clincher against Rain or Shine. PBA commissioner Willie Marcial revealed the sanction on Wednesday, hours after Abueva was summoned to the PBA Office in Libis. Abueva was handed a P20,000 fine for his dirty gesture directed at Rain or Shine rookie Deo Cuajao during the final seconds of Converge’s 120-109 win on Friday at Smart Araneta Coliseum for the franchise’s first semifinal appearance.
